card1_example: Firm owners ready to outsource their bookkeeping this quarter
card1_body: A firm doesn't hand over its books because an ad caught an owner mid-scroll. They switch when busy season or a resignation forces the search. These channels also need huge audiences, and 'owners ready to outsource accounting right now' is too small a slice to target.
card4_body: The only channel that scores green on the requirement that matters most: it puts Vteam in front of a firm the moment an owner or partner searches for help.
